text: {"lessons":["Most months I made no trades, and my account still rose overall; I should stay patient rather than trade in response to small short-term moves.","Selling some shares of both losing and winning positions did not by itself determine how the account performed; I should make each trade based on its effect on my overall risk and retirement needs, not on whether it locks in a gain or loss.","Because my savings and pension must support me throughout retirement, I should keep the portfolio appropriately balanced and avoid letting any single holding create a large risk to my account."]}
